```{r setup, include=FALSE}

library(readODS)
library(gtsummary) #summarytables

library(lme4) #mixed regression
library(lmerTest) #p-values for mixed regression
```

# Input data
```{r, echo = TRUE}

#Select pipeline
pipeline = 'EEGtrials' #alltrials; EEGtrials; delta_mediansplit

##For ALL trials (regardless of EEG information)
if (pipeline == 'alltrials' | pipeline == 'delta_mediansplit') {
  pathIn = "XXX/BEHAV/"
  fname = "behavior_singletrial_allparticipants.csv"
  dat_singletrial <- read.csv(paste(pathIn, fname, sep = ""))
} else {
  
  #For trials for which EEG and sleep stage info exists
  #Filenames
  #Collect TMR logfiles
  BEH_directory <- "XXX/BEHAV/"
  all_files <- list.files(BEH_directory, pattern = NULL, full.names = TRUE, recursive = TRUE)
  
  # Filter files that contain both "task-retrieval" and "sleepstages.csv"
  filtered_files <- all_files[grepl("task-retrieval", all_files) & grepl("sleeptages.csv", all_files)]
  
  # Loop over individual files
  dat_singletrial <- data.frame()
  for (file in filtered_files) {
    # Read the CSV file, assuming it has a header
    data <- read.csv(file)
    
    # Extract 'subid' from the filename; adjust the extraction logic as needed
    subid <- unlist(strsplit(file, "/"))[12] 
    
    # Add a column for 'subid' and set it to the extracted 'subid'
    data$subID <- subid
    data$acq <- 'acq-eeg'
    
    # Combine the current data with the combined data
    dat_singletrial <- rbind(dat_singletrial, data)
  }
}

#Participant list (tmr-log)
pathin_tmrlog <- 'XXX'
fname_tmrlog <- paste(pathin_tmrlog, 'TMR_log_cleaned_v2.csv', sep="")
data_tmrlog <- read_delim(fname_tmrlog, delim=",")
data_tmrlog <- data_tmrlog %>% filter(tmrlog_visitit=="eeg")

#Calculate age
data_tmrlog$birthdate <- as.Date(data_tmrlog$birthdate)
data_tmrlog$tmrlog_date <- as.Date(data_tmrlog$tmrlog_date)
data_tmrlog$age_in_years = as.numeric(difftime(data_tmrlog$tmrlog_date, data_tmrlog$birthdate, units = "days")) / 365.25 #accounts for leap years

#Join participant list with input data
sublist <- data_tmrlog %>% mutate(subID = paste("sub-", subject_id, sep = "")) %>% 
  select(subID, sex, age_in_years)
dat_singletrial <- left_join(dat_singletrial, sublist, by="subID")

if (pipeline == "delta_mediansplit") {
  main_directory <- "XXX/d_timefrequency/"    
  fname <- paste(main_directory, 'sleepitems_TF_highdelta.rds', sep="")
  load(fname)
  keepitems <- paste(dat_sleep_items$subID, dat_sleep_items$itemID)
  dat_singletrial$keepitems <- paste(dat_singletrial$subID, dat_singletrial$itemID)
  keepitems_logic <- dat_singletrial$keepitems %in% keepitems
  dat_singletrial <- dat_singletrial %>% filter(tmr_cued == 0 | keepitems_logic)
}

```

# Number of items
```{r}
#Nr of items for each participant and task phase
if (pipeline == 'alltrials' | pipeline == 'delta_mediansplit') {
  itemsummary <- dat_singletrial %>% group_by(subID, acq) %>% 
    dplyr::summarise(n_enc = sum(!is.na(encoding_run)),
                     n_afc1 = sum(!is.na(afc1_givenresp)),
                     n_afc2 = sum(!is.na(afc2_givenresp)),
                     n_afc3 = sum(!is.na(afc5_givenresp)),
                     n_retr = sum(!is.na(retrieval_run)),
                     #n_retr = sum(!is.na(run)), (different name in EEG-sleestaged datafile)
                     n_tmr_cued = sum(tmr_cued == 1),
                     n_tmr_uncued = sum(tmr_cued == 0 & condition != 3),
                     n_tmr_cued_afc1_correct = sum(tmr_cued == 1 & afc1_accuracy == 1),
                     n_tmr_cued_afc1_incorrect = sum(tmr_cued == 1 & afc1_accuracy == 0),
                     tmr_max_repetitions = max(tmr_repetitions, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
} else {
  itemsummary <- dat_singletrial %>% group_by(subID, acq) %>% 
    dplyr::summarise(n_enc = sum(!is.na(encoding_run)),
                     n_afc1 = sum(!is.na(afc1_givenresp)),
                     n_afc2 = sum(!is.na(afc2_givenresp)),
                     n_afc3 = sum(!is.na(afc5_givenresp)),
                     #n_retr = sum(!is.na(retrieval_run)),
                     n_retr = sum(!is.na(run)), #(different name in EEG-sleestaged datafile)
                     n_tmr_cued = sum(tmr_cued == 1),
                     n_tmr_uncued = sum(tmr_cued == 0 & condition != 3),
                     n_tmr_cued_afc1_correct = sum(tmr_cued == 1 & afc1_accuracy == 1),
                     n_tmr_cued_afc1_incorrect = sum(tmr_cued == 1 & afc1_accuracy == 0),
                     tmr_max_repetitions = max(tmr_repetitions, na.rm = TRUE) 
    )
}
  

#Summary table
itemsummary %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  dplyr::select(starts_with("n_"), "tmr_max_repetitions") %>% 
  tbl_summary(
  type = list(everything() ~ 'continuous2'),
  statistic = list(all_continuous2() ~ c("{mean} ({sd})",
                                        "{median} ({p25}, {p75})",
                                        "{min}, {max}")),
  missing = "ifany" # don't list missing data separately
) %>%
  add_n() %>% # add column with total number of non-missing observations
  modify_header(label = "**Variable**") %>% # update the column header
  bold_labels()


#List nr of participants at each step
itemsummary %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  dplyr::summarize(enc = sum(n_enc == 128),
            retr = sum(n_retr == 192),
            afc1 = sum(n_afc1 == 128),
            afc2 = sum(n_afc2 == 128),
            afc3 = sum(n_afc3 == 128),
            tmr = sum(n_tmr_cued == 64, na.rm = TRUE)) #at least 1 repetition

#Nr of participants with minimum required data for behavioral analysis (all encoding and retrieval runs + 1 TMR round)
itemsummary %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  dplyr::summarize(enc = sum(n_enc == 128 & n_afc1 == 128 & n_tmr_cued == 64 & n_retr == 192, na.rm = TRUE))
```


# Continue working with acq-EEG and discards participants without full data
```{r}
dat_singletrial <- dat_singletrial %>% filter(acq == "acq-eeg")
itemsummary <- itemsummary %>% filter(acq == "acq-eeg")

if (pipeline != "delta_mediansplit") {
  discardIDs <- itemsummary$subID[which(itemsummary$n_tmr_cued < 64 | #reduce the nr to 50, since some participants have lower values due to missing EEG, even though all trials were in reality included
                                          is.na(itemsummary$n_tmr_cued) | 
                                          itemsummary$n_retr == 0)]
  
  itemsummary <- itemsummary[-(which(itemsummary$subID %in% discardIDs)),]
  dat_singletrial <- dat_singletrial[-(which(dat_singletrial$subID %in% discardIDs)),]
  print(paste("Discarding participants from EEG: ", discardIDs, sep=""))
  length(unique(dat_singletrial$subID))
}
```

# For EEG-informed analysis, discard items that were presented during not-NREM stage at least once
```{r}
if (pipeline == 'EEGtrials') {
  dat_singletrial <- dat_singletrial %>% 
    filter(n_notNREM < 1 | is.na(n_notNREM))
}
```


# Data cleaning
```{r}
# Discard all retrieval new items from single-trial data
dat_singletrial <- dat_singletrial %>% filter(condition != 3)


#Replace NaN's with NA-s for R-compatibility
dat_singletrial <- dat_singletrial %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ ifelse(is.nan(.), NA, .)))

#Variables into appropriate data-types
## outcome variables
dat_singletrial$afc1_accuracy <- as.numeric(dat_singletrial$afc1_accuracy)
dat_singletrial$afc2_accuracy <- as.numeric(dat_singletrial$afc2_accuracy)
dat_singletrial$afc5_accuracy <- as.numeric(dat_singletrial$afc5_accuracy)
dat_singletrial$retrieval_accuracy <- as.numeric(dat_singletrial$retrieval_accuracy)


dat_singletrial$afc1_givenresp <- as.numeric(dat_singletrial$afc1_givenresp)
#naming typo in the two different data-files (with our without sleep-EEG-stage information)
if (pipeline == 'alltrials' | pipeline == 'delta_mediansplit') {
  dat_singletrial$afc_correcresponse <- as.numeric(dat_singletrial$afc_correcresponse)
} else {
  dat_singletrial$afc_correcresponse <- as.numeric(dat_singletrial$afc_correctresp)
}

## TMR: factorize and rename factor levels for better interpretability
dat_singletrial$tmr_cued <- as.factor(dat_singletrial$tmr_cued)
dat_singletrial <- dat_singletrial %>%
  mutate(tmr_cued = fct_recode(factor(tmr_cued),
    "cued"   = "1",
    "uncued" = "0"
  ))
unique(dat_singletrial$tmr_cued)
count(dat_singletrial$tmr_cued)

## encoding vivdness
dat_singletrial$encoding_vividness <- as.numeric(dat_singletrial$encoding_vividness)
unique(dat_singletrial$encoding_vividness)
count(dat_singletrial$encoding_vividness)

## covariates
dat_singletrial$sex <- as.factor(dat_singletrial$sex)
dat_singletrial$subID <- as.factor(dat_singletrial$subID)
dat_singletrial$itemID <- as.factor(dat_singletrial$itemID)
dat_singletrial$condition <- as.factor(dat_singletrial$condition)
dat_singletrial$conditionID <- as.factor(dat_singletrial$conditionID)


#Calculate AFC1-accuracy at the category level
dat_singletrial <- dat_singletrial %>% 
  mutate(correct_category_afc1 = ifelse(((afc_correcresponse <= 4 & afc1_givenresp <= 4) | 
                                           (afc_correcresponse > 4 & afc1_givenresp > 4)),
                                        "correct", "incorrect"
  )
  )
dat_singletrial$correct_category_afc1 <- as.factor(dat_singletrial$correct_category_afc1)
levels(dat_singletrial$correct_category_afc1)
count(dat_singletrial$correct_category_afc1)


#Calculate new variable for AFC1-performance w three levels: category incorrect, cat-correct-item-incorrect, cat-correct-item-correct
dat_singletrial <- dat_singletrial %>% 
  mutate(pre_performance = case_when(
    correct_category_afc1 == "incorrect" ~ "cat_incorrect",
    correct_category_afc1 == "correct" & afc1_accuracy == 0 ~ "cat_correct_item_incorrect",
    correct_category_afc1 == "correct" & afc1_accuracy == 1 ~ "cat_correct_item_correct"
  )) 
dat_singletrial$pre_performance <- as.factor(dat_singletrial$pre_performance)
levels(dat_singletrial$pre_performance)
count(dat_singletrial$pre_performance)





count(dat_singletrial$afc1_accuracy)
count(dat_singletrial$afc2_accuracy)
count(dat_singletrial$afc5_accuracy)
count(dat_singletrial$retrieval_accuracy)

#Check how the percentages are of cued/uncued items, based on pre-sleep performance
dat_design <- dat_singletrial %>% 
  group_by(subID) %>% 
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_cued = sum(tmr_cued == "cued"),
    n_uncued = sum(tmr_cued == "uncued"),
    n_cued_strong = sum(tmr_cued == "cued"& pre_performance == "cat_correct_item_correct"),
    n_uncued_strong = sum(tmr_cued == "uncued"& pre_performance == "cat_correct_item_correct"),
    n_cued_weak = sum(tmr_cued == "cued"& pre_performance == "cat_correct_item_incorrect"),
    n_uncued_weak = sum(tmr_cued == "uncued"& pre_performance == "cat_correct_item_incorrect"),
    n_cued_null = sum(tmr_cued == "cued"& pre_performance == "cat_incorrect"),
    n_uncued_null = sum(tmr_cued == "uncued"& pre_performance == "cat_incorrect"),
    p_cued_strong = (n_cued_strong/n_cued)*100,
    p_uncued_strong = (n_uncued_strong/n_uncued)*100,
    p_cued_weak = (n_cued_weak/n_cued)*100,
    p_uncued_weak = (n_uncued_weak/n_uncued)*100,
    p_cued_null = (n_cued_null/n_cued)*100,
    p_uncued_null = (n_uncued_null/n_uncued)*100,
    p_cued_control = p_cued_strong + p_cued_weak + p_cued_null,
    p_uncued_control = p_uncued_strong + p_uncued_weak + p_uncued_null
  )

dat_design_summary <- dat_design %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  dplyr::summarise(across(where(is.numeric), list(mean = ~mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
                                             sd   = ~sd(.x, na.rm = TRUE))))
```


# Summarize pre-sleep (baseline) performance
```{r}
#Overall performance (afc1-correct item)
dat_singletrial %>% 
  group_by(subID) %>% 
  dplyr::summarise(mean_afc1 = mean(afc1_accuracy)) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  dplyr::summarise(mean_afc1_group = mean(mean_afc1),
                   sd_afc1_group = sd(mean_afc1))
  
  
# Step 1: participant-level percentages, with zeros for empty cells
dat_pre_perf <- dat_singletrial %>%
  group_by(subID, pre_performance, tmr_cued) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(subID, pre_performance) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(percentage = n / sum(n) * 100) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(-n) %>%
  # Complete missing combinations with zero
  complete(subID, pre_performance, tmr_cued, fill = list(percentage = 0))


# Step 2: group-level summary
dat_pre_perf_group <- dat_pre_perf %>%
  group_by(pre_performance, tmr_cued) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    mean_percentage = mean(percentage, na.rm = TRUE),
    se              = sd(percentage, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    .groups         = "drop"
  )


# Step 3: plot
ggplot() +
  # Single participant dots
  geom_point(
    data    = dat_pre_perf,
    aes(x = pre_performance, y = percentage, color = tmr_cued, group = tmr_cued),
    alpha   = 0.2,
    #color   = "gray50",
    position = position_jitter(width = 0.05)
  ) +
  # Group mean lines
  geom_line(
    data = dat_pre_perf_group,
    aes(x = pre_performance, y = mean_percentage, color = tmr_cued, group = tmr_cued)
  ) +
  # Group mean points
  geom_point(
    data = dat_pre_perf_group,
    aes(x = pre_performance, y = mean_percentage, color = tmr_cued),
    size = 3
  ) +
  # Error bars
  geom_errorbar(
    data = dat_pre_perf_group,
    aes(x = pre_performance, y = mean_percentage, color = tmr_cued,
        ymin = mean_percentage - 1.96 * se,
        ymax = mean_percentage + 1.96 * se),
    width = 0.1
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(
    labels = c(
      "cat_correct_item_correct"   = "Cat+Item+",
      "cat_correct_item_incorrect" = "Cat+Item-",
      "cat_incorrect"              = "Cat-"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Percentage of trials (%)"
  ) +
  theme_classic()
```

# Single trial analysis
```{r}
#Select variables
dat_singletrial_crop <- dat_singletrial %>% 
  select(subID, itemID, encoding_vividness, tmr_cued,
         afc2_accuracy, afc5_accuracy, 
         pre_performance,
         condition,
         age_in_years, sex)


#Data into long format
dat_singletrial_crop_long <- dat_singletrial_crop %>%  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("afc"), values_to = "p_success", names_to = "time")

#Factorize time
dat_singletrial_crop_long$time <- as.factor(dat_singletrial_crop_long$time)

#Set contrasts
contrasts(dat_singletrial_crop_long$tmr_cued) <- c(-0.5, 0.5)
contrasts(dat_singletrial_crop_long$time) <- c(-0.5, 0.5)
contrasts(dat_singletrial_crop_long$pre_performance) <- c(-0.5, 0.5)
contrasts(dat_singletrial_crop_long$condition) <- c(-0.5, 0.5)
contrasts(dat_singletrial_crop_long$sex) <- c(-0.5, 0.5)

#Original model: main effects + time_interaction
mod_orig <- glmer(p_success ~ encoding_vividness + time*tmr_cued + 
                    pre_performance*tmr_cued +
                    pre_performance*time +
                    condition +
                    age_in_years + sex +
                    (1 | subID/itemID), 
                  data = dat_singletrial_crop_long, 
                  family = binomial, nAGQ = 0L)
summary(mod_orig)


mod_orig <- glmer(p_success ~ encoding_vividness + time + tmr_cued + pre_performance +
                    pre_performance*tmr_cued +
                    time*tmr_cued +
                    pre_performance*time +
                    condition +
                    age_in_years + sex +
                    (1 | subID/itemID), 
                  data = dat_singletrial_crop_long, 
                  family = binomial, nAGQ = 0L)




#Vividness interactions
mod_vivint <- glmer(p_success ~ time*encoding_vividness*tmr_cued +
                      pre_performance*tmr_cued + 
                      pre_performance*time +
                      condition +
                      age_in_years + sex +
                      (1 | subID/itemID), 
                    data = dat_singletrial_crop_long, 
                    family = binomial, nAGQ = 0L)
summary(mod_vivint)

#Category interactions
mod_categoryint <- glmer(p_success ~ time*tmr_cued*condition +
                           pre_performance*tmr_cued + 
                           pre_performance*time +
                       encoding_vividness +
                       age_in_years + sex +
                       (1 | subID/itemID), 
               data = dat_singletrial_crop_long, 
              family = binomial, nAGQ = 0L)
summary(mod_categoryint)


#Model copmarisons
cbind(
  AIC(mod_orig, mod_vivint, mod_categoryint),
  BIC(mod_orig, mod_vivint, mod_categoryint))[, c(1, 2, 4)] %>% 
  mutate(
    model = rownames(.)
  )

anova(mod_orig, mod_vivint)
anova(mod_orig, mod_categoryint)

```

# Effect sizes of the selected model
```{r}
mod_select = mod_orig


#Odd's ratios
ors <- exp(cbind(OR = fixef(mod_select), confint(mod_select, parm = "beta_", method = "Wald")))

#AMEs for continous variables
ame_cont <- avg_slopes(mod_select, variables = c("encoding_vividness", "age_in_years"),
           type = "response", re.form = NA)

#AMEs for categorical variables
ame_cat <- avg_comparisons(mod_select, 
                           variables = c("tmr_cued", "time", "pre_performance", "condition", "sex"),
                           type = "response", re.form = NA)

#AMEs for significant interaction terms
ame_int_tmr_preperf <- avg_comparisons(mod_select, 
                           variables = c("tmr_cued"),
                           by = "pre_performance",
                           type = "response", re.form = NA)

ame_int_time_preperf <- avg_comparisons(mod_select, 
                           variables = c("time"),
                           by = "pre_performance",
                           type = "response", re.form = NA)

#Random effects
re <- as.data.frame(VarCorr(mod_select))
re

ngrps(mod_select)
nobs(mod_select)
```

# Selected model into table
```{r}
## ---- 1. Edit these three blocks to match your model ------------------

# Coefficient name (as in summary) -> label in the table
labels <- c(
  "(Intercept)"    = "Intercept",
  "encoding_vividness"          = "vividness",
  "time1"           = "test time",
  "tmr_cued1"       = "TMR",
  "pre_performance1"          = "pre-sleep baseline",
  "condition1" = "category",
  "age_in_years" = "age (years)",
  "sex1" = "sex",
  "time1:tmr_cued1"  = "TMR \u00d7 test time",
  "tmr_cued1:preperf1" = "TMR \u00d7 pre-sleep baseline",
  "time1:pre_performance1 " = "test time \u00d7 pre-sleep baseline"
)

# Coefficient name -> term name in ame_cont / ame_cat (main effects only)
ame_map <- c(
  "age_in_years"    = "age_in_years",
  "encoding_vividness"     = "encoding_vividness",
  "condition1" = "condition",
  "pre_performance1"    = "pre_performance",
  "sex1" = "sex",
  "time1" = "time",
  "tmr_cued1" = "tmr_cued") 

# Significant interactions: coefficient name -> simple-effect AMEs and the
# 'by' variable used to compute them
int_map <- list(
  "tmr_cued1:pre_performance1"  = list(ame = ame_int_tmr_preperf,  by = "pre_performance"),
  "time1:pre_performance1" = list(ame = ame_int_time_preperf, by = "pre_performance")
)

out_file <- "table_mod_behavior.txt"

## ---- 2. Helpers -----------------------------------------------------
fmt    <- function(x, d = 2) formatC(x, format = "f", digits = d)
fmt_ci <- function(lo, hi, d = 2) paste0("[", fmt(lo, d), ", ", fmt(hi, d), "]")
fmt_p  <- function(p) ifelse(p < .001, "< .001",
                             sub("^0", "", formatC(p, format = "f", digits = 3)))
lab    <- function(nm) if (nm %in% names(labels)) labels[[nm]] else nm

## ---- 3. Build the table ---------------------------------------------
cf <- summary(mod_select)$coefficients

cols <- c("term", "estimate", "conf.low", "conf.high")
ame_main <- rbind(as.data.frame(ame_cont)[, cols],
                  as.data.frame(ame_cat)[, cols])

out <- paste("Predictor", "OR", "95% CI", "p", "AME (pp)", "95% CI", sep = "\t")

for (nm in rownames(cf)) {
  # main-effect AME, if this coefficient has one
  a <- ame_main[ame_main$term %in% ame_map[nm], ]
  ame_txt <- if (nrow(a) == 1) {
    c(fmt(100 * a$estimate), fmt_ci(100 * a$conf.low, 100 * a$conf.high))
  } else c("", "")

  out <- c(out, paste(lab(nm),
                      fmt(ors[nm, 1]), fmt_ci(ors[nm, 2], ors[nm, 3]),
                      fmt_p(cf[nm, 4]),
                      ame_txt[1], ame_txt[2], sep = "\t"))

  # simple-effect AMEs under significant interactions
  if (nm %in% names(int_map)) {
    x   <- as.data.frame(int_map[[nm]]$ame)
    byv <- int_map[[nm]]$by
    for (i in seq_len(nrow(x))) {
      out <- c(out, paste(
        paste0("    ", x$term[i], " at ", byv, " = ", x[[byv]][i]),
        "", "", "",
        fmt(100 * x$estimate[i]),
        fmt_ci(100 * x$conf.low[i], 100 * x$conf.high[i]), sep = "\t"))
    }
  }
}

## ---- 3b. Random effects ----------------------------------------------
re_labels <- c("itemID:subID" = "Item within participant (intercept)",
               "subID"        = "Participant (intercept)")

re <- as.data.frame(VarCorr(mod_select))
ng <- ngrps(mod_select)

out <- c(out, "", "Random effects",
         paste("Grouping factor", "Variance", "SD", "N groups", sep = "\t"))

for (i in seq_len(nrow(re))) {
  g <- re$grp[i]
  out <- c(out, paste(if (g %in% names(re_labels)) re_labels[[g]] else g,
                      fmt(re$vcov[i], 3), fmt(re$sdcor[i], 3),
                      format(ng[[g]], big.mark = ","), sep = "\t"))
}

out <- c(out, paste("N observations",
                    format(nobs(mod_select), big.mark = ","), sep = "\t"))

## ---- 3c. Model fit ---------------------------------------------------
var_fix  <- var(as.vector(getME(mod_select, "X") %*% fixef(mod_select)))
var_rand <- sum(re$vcov)      # random-intercept variances from 3b
var_res  <- pi^2 / 3          # residual variance, logit link
tot      <- var_fix + var_rand + var_res

out <- c(out, "", "Model fit",
         paste("Marginal R\u00b2",    fmt(var_fix / tot, 3), sep = "\t"),
         paste("Conditional R\u00b2", fmt((var_fix + var_rand) / tot, 3), sep = "\t"))

## ---- 3d. Note --------------------------------------------------------
outcome <- "memory item accuracy"   # wording for the outcome

form <- gsub("\\s+", " ", paste(deparse(formula(mod_select), width.cutoff = 500L),
                                collapse = ""))
nagq <- if (!is.null(mod_select@call$nAGQ)) eval(mod_select@call$nAGQ) else 1
est  <- if (nagq == 0) "nAGQ = 0" else if (nagq == 1) "Laplace approximation" else
          paste0("adaptive Gauss-Hermite quadrature, nAGQ = ", nagq)

note <- paste0(
  "Note. Logistic generalized linear mixed model (binomial distribution, logit link) ",
  "fitted by maximum likelihood with lme4 (", est, "). Model: ", form, ". ",
  "Categorical predictors were contrast-coded (\u22120.5, 0.5). ",
  "OR = odds ratio with Wald 95% confidence interval; p-values are from Wald z tests. ",
  "For continuous predictors, ORs are per one-unit increase; for categorical predictors, ",
  "ORs compare the two levels, averaged over the levels of the other factors; ",
  "for interactions, ORs are ratios of odds ratios. ",
  "AME = average marginal effect on the probability of ", outcome,
  ", in percentage points, with delta-method 95% confidence intervals, computed with ",
  "the marginaleffects package with random effects set to zero. ",
  "For continuous predictors, AMEs are per one-unit increase; for categorical predictors, ",
  "they are the difference between levels. AMEs for main effects are averaged over the ",
  "observed values of all other predictors. For significant interactions, AMEs are given ",
  "as simple effects, i.e. the effect of one factor at each level of the other (indented rows); ",
  "no AMEs are given for non-significant interactions. ",
  "Random-effect variances and SDs are on the logit scale. ",
  "Marginal and conditional R\u00b2 (Nakagawa et al., 2017) give the proportion of ",
  "latent-scale variance explained by the fixed effects alone and by the fixed and ",
  "random effects together, using the logit residual variance \u03c0\u00b2/3."
)

## ---- 4. Write -------------------------------------------------------
con <- file(out_file, open = "w", encoding = "UTF-8")
writeLines(out, con)
close(con)
cat(out, sep = "\n")
```



# Visualization of the selected model
```{r}
# Get PabloPicasso palette
pal <- paletteer_d("lisa::PabloPicasso_1")

# ── Figure 1: Vividness main effect ──────────────────────────────────────────

# Aggregate: per participant per vividness level
vividness_subj <- dat_singletrial_crop_long %>%
  filter(!is.na(encoding_vividness)) %>%
  group_by(subID, encoding_vividness) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(p_correct = mean(p_success, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# Cell means + 95% CI
vividness_means <- summarySEwithin(
  data = vividness_subj,
  measurevar = "p_correct",
  withinvars = "encoding_vividness",
  idvar = "subID",
  na.rm = TRUE
)

fig1 <- ggplot(vividness_means, aes(x = factor(encoding_vividness), y = p_correct)) +
  geom_jitter(data = vividness_subj, 
              aes(x = factor(encoding_vividness), y = p_correct),
              width = 0.1, alpha = 0.3, size = 1.5, color = "grey50") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = p_correct - ci, ymax = p_correct + ci), 
                width = 0.1, linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  geom_line(aes(group = 1), linewidth = 0.8) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), labels = scales::percent) +
  labs(
    x = "Encoding vividness",
    y = "Proportion exemplar-correct (%)",
    title = "Effect of encoding vividness"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 8)

#fig1


# ── Figure 2: TMR x time x pre_performance ───────────────────────────────────

# Recode labels
dat_plot <- dat_singletrial_crop_long %>%
  mutate(
    pre_perf_label = factor(pre_performance,
                            levels = c("cat_correct_item_correct", "cat_correct_item_incorrect"),
                            labels = c("Strong\n(exemplar correct)",
                                       "Weak\n(exemplar incorrect)")),
    time_label = factor(time,
                        levels = c("afc2_accuracy", "afc5_accuracy"),
                        labels = c("Item-test 2\n(~12 hours)", "Item-test 3\n(~5 days)")),
    tmr_label = factor(tmr_cued, levels = c("cued", "uncued"), 
                       labels = c("cued", "uncued"))
  )

# Aggregate: per participant per cell
tmr_subj <- dat_plot %>%
  group_by(subID, tmr_label, time_label, pre_perf_label) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(p_correct = mean(p_success, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# Cell means + 95% CI
tmr_means <- summarySEwithin(
  data = tmr_subj,
  measurevar = "p_correct",
  withinvars = c("tmr_label", "time_label", "pre_perf_label"),
  idvar = "subID",
  na.rm = TRUE
)

fig2 <- ggplot(tmr_means, aes(x = time_label, y = p_correct,
```
